published_rejoin.corrected_fact: After polynomial criticalization, assigning a remaining variable either truth value yields either an immediately terminal cofactor or a nonterminal cofactor whose maximum deficiency is at most one below the parent critical rank.
published_rejoin.terminal_exception: Maximum-deficiency descent is asserted only for nonterminal children. A child containing an empty clause, or otherwise closed by an exact terminal test, is handled before merge and need not carry delta*<=k-1.
published_rejoin.meaning: The unresolved cost is preserving the SAT disjunction only when both descended children remain nonterminal.

global_accounting_constants.statement: There must exist fixed constants a,b independent of the input and of k.
global_accounting_constants.state_envelope: Every normalized nonterminal CNF state plus all live replay/merge metadata has encoded size at most N^a, where N is the original input size.
global_accounting_constants.work_envelope: Criticalization, child handling, merge, normalization, and replay bookkeeping per macrostep cost at most N^b.

critical_state.input: delta*-critical nonterminal CNF G within the N^a state envelope
critical_state.choose: one fixed deterministic remaining variable x
critical_state.corrected_branchwise_rule: For each epsilon: either G_epsilon is closed terminally, or it is nonterminal and delta*(G_epsilon)<=k-1.

terminal_child_dispatch.SAT_child: If either child is terminal SAT, the parent is terminal SAT; lift that child's witness with x=epsilon. No OR-merge is needed.
terminal_child_dispatch.one_UNSAT_one_nonterminal: If exactly one child is terminal UNSAT and the other is nonterminal, the parent SAT status equals the nonterminal child's SAT status; continue with that single child. No OR-merge is needed.
terminal_child_dispatch.both_UNSAT: If both children are terminal UNSAT, the parent is terminal UNSAT after replayable composition of the two branch certificates.
terminal_child_dispatch.merge_case: Invoke M only when both children are nonterminal and both satisfy delta*<=k-1.

target_operator.name: MAXDEF_DESCENT_PRESERVING_OR_MERGE
target_operator.precondition: G0 and G1 are both nonterminal CNF children of one critical parent G and each has delta*<=k-1.

obligations.M2_RANK_PRESERVATION: M returns a CNF state Q with delta*(Q)<=k-1, or an exact terminal marker.
obligations.M3_POLYNOMIAL_CONSTRUCTION: Merge construction and its proof metadata cost at most N^b for fixed b independent of k.
obligations.M4_POLYNOMIAL_LIVE_STATE: Q plus all merge/replay metadata fits within the fixed N^a live-state envelope.
obligations.M5_REPLAY: Any downstream SAT witness or UNSAT certificate lifts through M and the x-branch split to the parent G in N^O(1) total charged work under the fixed replay envelope.
obligations.M6_RANK_MONOTONE_CLOSURE: A fixed exact polynomial normalization Norm applied to nonterminal Q returns either a terminal or the next critical CNF G' with delta*(G')<=delta*(Q)<=k-1, while preserving the N^a state envelope and N^b per-step work envelope.

argument: A fixed polynomial criticalization maps the original CNF to a terminal or a critical CNF state within the N^a envelope; hence initial rank k0<=number_of_clauses<=N^a.
At each critical state, dispatch terminal children before any merge.
If exactly one nonterminal child survives, continue with it; its rank is at most k-1.
If both children remain nonterminal, apply M and then rank-monotone Norm; the next critical rank is at most k-1.
Thus every nonterminal macrostep decreases the nonnegative integer rank by at least one.
There are at most N^a nonterminal macrosteps, not necessarily at most N.
With fixed N^b charged work per macrostep, fixed N^a live state, and polynomial replay, total computation is polynomial in N.
consequence_if_proved.result: A universal fixed M and Norm satisfying the corrected obligations would give a deterministic polynomial SAT decider and therefore P=NP.

known_failed_natural_merges.selector_merge: Exact OR semantics but reifies the binary choice and does not establish maxdef descent.
known_failed_natural_merges.ordinary_CNF_DP_projection: Exact projection, but R44AS-RANK gives an explicit maxdef rebound example.
known_failed_natural_merges.auxiliary_free_CNF_projection: Parity projection can require exponentially many clauses.
known_failed_natural_merges.quantifier_hiding: Keeps small syntax/rank but defers SAT to terminal evaluation.
